findings.desc: Scope-shrinkage confirmation is not mechanically aligned with the decision doc. The doc requires a scope-shrinkage decision with userConfirmed:true and says reviewer/agent judgment is not enough (docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:480-496), but the shipped command/data model only records decision, removedMilestoneIds, reason, and approvedBy, with approvedBy documented as human or agent and no userConfirmed field (packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2071-2077; packages/main/src/core/types.ts:1889-1895). DONE equivalence then treats any decision=confirmed as accepted shrinkage and skips those milestones (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:986-988,1010-1012). This lets an agent-authored shrinkage artifact satisfy DONE intent equivalence for a narrower outcome, contrary to the documented user-confirmation gate.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by adding userConfirmed to scope_shrinkage_decision_set schema/types and requiring userConfirmed:true for confirmed shrinkage; DONE equivalence now consumes shrinkage only when decision=confirmed and userConfirmed=true. Verified by build, ProofStory smoke, and process-fact contract.

findings.desc: M4/M9 ProofStory DEV enforcement is not covered on rollback/re-entry and appears bypassable. packages/main/src/core/config.ts:53 documents devGateMode as covering PLAN/INIT_CHECK/REVIEW rollback DEV admission, but packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:579 implements canReenterDevGuard with only the parallelDevEntryBlock check and no proofStoryDevGateFailure call. The guard-failure path likewise skips ProofStory for rollback because packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:982 only evaluates proofStoryDevGateFailure when !isRollbackDoor. The current smoke verifies direct proofstory_gate_check enforce failure at packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:279 and that diagnostics do not advance phase at packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:335, but it never exercises story_advance DEV from REVIEW/TEST under proofStory.devGateMode=enforce. A story can therefore pass the smoke/build/process-fact evidence while the lifecycle policy gate is absent on a documented DEV entry path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by applying proofStoryDevGateFailure to REVIEW/TEST -> DEV re-entry via canReenterDevGuard and guard failure rendering; smoke now exercises PLAN->DEV plus REVIEW/TEST->DEV lifecycle blocking under proofStory.devGateMode=enforce. Verified by build, ProofStory smoke, and process-fact contract.

findings.desc: The ProofStory execution plan command/artifact inventory does not match the implemented CLI surface. The doc lists current New Commands that are not registered or implemented, including intent_collision_start/record/resolve, acceptance_contract_set/acceptance_criterion_add/acceptance_evidence_bind, red_evidence_validate, minimality_check_set/minimality_alternative_record, risk_classify, and assurance_level_set (docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:950-993), while the catalog exposes the implemented ProofStory commands without those names and adds proofstory_review_completeness_check instead (packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2026-2156). The Storage section also calls intent-coverage-check.json, done-intent-equivalence.json, acceptance-contract.json, and minimality-check.json new gate-consumed artifacts (docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:1026-1042), but the store only persists original-intent-snapshot.json, milestone-ledger.json, proofstory.json, intent-collision.json, scope-shrinkage-decision.json, red-evidence.json, and spike.json (packages/main/src/core/store.ts:655-743), and the coverage/equivalence/check handlers are read-only diagnostics (packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts:391-420). This leaves the requirements doc as a misleading operator/spec source for command names and gate evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed the decision doc command and artifact inventory: implemented MVP commands are separated from future proposals, read-only diagnostics are not listed as durable artifacts, and acceptance bindings are documented as proofstory_contract_set.acceptanceBindings. Verified by docs review and build/smoke/process-fact contract.

findings.desc: ProofStory is specified as a pre-DEV contract layer: M3 requires PLAN-only mutation policy for intent_collision_set, M4/M6/M7 require the gate/red/spike artifacts to block before DEV in enforce mode, and the gate outputs say incomplete ProofStory work should stay in PLAN. The implementation registers the core ProofStory artifact writers as story-scoped gate evidence but allows them in DEV in both command-policy and DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS: original_intent_snapshot_set, milestone_ledger_set/add, proofstory_contract_set, intent_collision_set, red_evidence_create, and spike_* can all be written after implementation has started. That lets agents backfill or revise the intent/collision/contract/red/spike record during DEV instead of proving it before DEV, weakening the M0-M9 conceptual boundary even though the diagnostics themselves are pure and do not create a second lifecycle state machine. Narrow these pre-DEV artifact writers to INIT/PLAN as appropriate, leaving only explicit scope-shrinkage/DONE-time decisions in later phases, and update phase allowlist plus command policy together. Source refs: packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts:356, :358, :361, :363, :367, :369; packages/main/src/core/config.ts:304, :325; docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:1144, :1165, :1210, :1227.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by restricting core ProofStory pre-DEV artifact writers to INIT/PLAN or PLAN in command policy and default phase tools; only explicit scope shrinkage remains allowed after DEV with userConfirmed:true semantics. Verified by process-fact contract and smoke.

findings.desc: ProofStory gate-consumed artifacts are misclassified in the process-fact contract. packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts:35-42 defines L3 as durable artifacts not directly consumed by lifecycle gates and L4 as lifecycle gate consumed facts, but the new ProofStory writer commands remain L3/L2 at packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts:283-296 even though their own rationales say they are consumed by opt-in enforcement. Runtime does consume these artifacts in lifecycle gates: DEV admission reads them through proofStoryDevGateFailure in packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:148-154 and REVIEW/DONE gates read them in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:292-309 and :460-477. The artifact registry also marks milestone-ledger/proofstory/intent-collision/scope-shrinkage/red-evidence as L3 while assigning consumerGate text at packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts:904-950. This violates the registry definition and makes audit/doctor consumers under-report the new ProofStory gate evidence instead of treating it as L4 with explicit gateConsumer coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by classifying ProofStory gate-consumed writer commands and artifacts as L4 with explicit ProofStory DEV admission, REVIEW completeness, and DONE intent-equivalence consumers in process-fact levels/registry. Verified by scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: ProofStory REVIEW/DONE coverage treats deferred gate waivers as completed evidence. The shared verification schema says verdict does not override pass/fail and waiverType=deferred_gate_evidence is temporary evidence that later validate must replace (packages/main/src/cli/command-schemas.ts:70-71); the main verification engine preserves that distinction by marking such rows deferred before normal waiver/covered handling (packages/main/src/core/verification.ts:94-117). ProofStory collapses all waiver rows into success in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:521-527, and both DONE equivalence and REVIEW completeness consume that helper at packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1013-1015 and :1063-1069. As a result proofstory_review_completeness_check --mode=enforce and done_intent_equivalence_check --mode=enforce can report pass for an intent that only has temporary deferred_gate_evidence, drifting from the verification engine semantics and making the standalone ProofStory gate reports too optimistic.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by changing ProofStory evidence coverage so deferred_gate_evidence never covers, ordinary evidence requires result=pass, and permanent waivers cover only when not failed. Smoke now covers result=fail with verdict success, failed waiver, and deferred waiver. Verified by build, ProofStory smoke, and process-fact contract.

findings.desc: The CLI help text for proofstory_contract_set/get still describes the artifact as a minimal diagnostic envelope with no gate enforcement (packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:2049-2055), but the runtime now writes diagnosticOnly:false in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:820-829 and the command policy says the contract is consumed by diagnostics and opt-in enforcement at packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts:361. Operators reading lattice help will be told the contract has no gate role even though review/DONE/dev opt-in policies can consume it. Update the command descriptions and field descriptions to match the new gate-consumable semantics.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed CLI help text for proofstory_contract_set/get to describe the contract envelope as consumed by diagnostics and opt-in gates. Verified by reviewer inspection and process-fact contract.

findings.desc: The updated Storage and Process Facts section now matches the implemented MVP artifact inventory, but the earlier Artifact Model section still says the ProofStory layer should write one canonical structured artifact, proofstory.json (docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:223-231). The implementation and process-fact contract deliberately use a split set of durable ProofStory gate artifacts: the store writes original-intent-snapshot.json, milestone-ledger.json, proofstory.json, intent-collision.json, scope-shrinkage-decision.json, red-evidence.json, and spike.json (packages/main/src/core/store.ts:655-743), and the process-fact contract asserts those seven artifacts (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:645-653). Leaving the earlier one-artifact model in the same decision doc can mislead operators into treating proofstory.json as the only durable ProofStory artifact even though the CLI/store and later doc inventory require the split artifact model.

ProofStory REVIEW/DONE gates still let verdict override a failed result. The shared verification schema states that verdict does not override the result pass/fail gate (packages/main/src/cli/command-schemas.ts:70), and buildVerificationCoverage marks result=fail as failed before coverage (packages/main/src/core/verification.ts:116-125). But ProofStory evidenceCoversIntent returns true for row.verdict=success or waived even when row.result=fail (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:522-530), and both evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence and evaluateReviewCompleteness consume that helper (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1022 and :1072). I verified this against current HEAD with a node --input-type=module probe importing packages/main/dist/core/proofstory.js: a checklist row with kind=logic_test, result=fail, verdict=success made done_intent_equivalence and review_completeness both return status=pass in enforce mode. The targeted smoke only covers deferred_gate_evidence and therefore does not lock the broader pass/fail verdict semantics. This lets failed evidence satisfy ProofStory gate-consumed facts.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed evidence semantics: ProofStory no longer treats verdict labels as proof; result=fail with verdict success or failed waiver does not satisfy REVIEW/DONE coverage. Smoke and process-fact contract assert this behavior. Verified by build and ProofStory smoke.

findings.desc: Current HEAD still lacks executable coverage for ProofStory devGateMode=enforce DEV admission paths. The implementation now calls proofStoryDevGateFailure from canStartDevGuard and canReenterDevGuard (packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:506-514 and :581-587), but the dedicated ProofStory smoke never configures proofStory.devGateMode and never invokes story_advance, canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, or canReenterDevGuard. Verified by rg -n --glob "!**/.omx/**" "devGateMode|story_advance|ProofStory DEV gate|canReenterDevGuard|canStartDevGuard" packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts returning no matches. The smoke only drives proofstory_gate_check enforce directly (packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:279-280) and checks diagnostics do not advance phase (packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:362-363). The userConfirmed shrinkage and deferred_gate_evidence cases are present in that smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:316-352), and process-fact assertions exist, but the lifecycle assertion is source-text only (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:582-583). Therefore node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.js and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs pass without proving PLAN->DEV or REVIEW/TEST->DEV rollback/re-entry block under proofStory.devGateMode=enforce. Add an executable smoke or machine test that seeds missing ProofStory artifacts under devGateMode=enforce and asserts PLAN->DEV plus REVIEW->DEV and TEST->DEV are refused with the ProofStory gate message.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed coverage by adding execution-level smoke for proofStory.devGateMode=enforce through machine helper and actual story_advance DEV blocking for PLAN, REVIEW, and TEST DEV-entry/re-entry paths. Verified by build, ProofStory smoke, and process-fact contract.
